description:
## What

Ship Multipurpose generation Profile types as siblings to the Strict
tier types decided in PKIX-jbvb.6 / implemented in PKIX-jbvb.7.

Decision recorded in PKIX-jbvb.8 (Mark 2026-05-13): yes, ship them,
chained after the Strict surface is complete.

## Eventual surface

Eight `pkix-profiles-cabf` S/MIME Profile types total (one per BR cell
that is not Legacy-banned):

| Validation tier | Strict (`.3`) | Multipurpose (`.2`) |
|---|---|---|
| Mailbox | `SmimeMailboxValidated` (renamed from `SmimeProfile` — PKIX-jbvb.9.0) | `SmimeMailboxValidatedMultipurpose` (PKIX-jbvb.9.1) |
| Organization | `SmimeOrganizationValidated` (PKIX-jbvb.1) | `SmimeOrganizationValidatedMultipurpose` (PKIX-jbvb.9.2) |
| Sponsor | `SmimeSponsorValidated` ✓ (PKIX-jbvb.7) | `SmimeSponsorValidatedMultipurpose` (PKIX-jbvb.9.3) |
| Individual | `SmimeIndividualValidated` ✓ (PKIX-jbvb.7) | `SmimeIndividualValidatedMultipurpose` (PKIX-jbvb.9.4) |

Each Multipurpose sibling differs from its Strict counterpart in:

- Policy OID (`.2` vs `.3` suffix)
- EKU permissiveness — Strict requires `id-kp-emailProtection` ONLY;
  Multipurpose allows additional EKU values (document-signing crossover)
- A few extension permissiveness differences per §7.1.2.3(f) tables

Same DN rules per tier. Same 825-day validity cap. Same baseline.

## Children

- **PKIX-jbvb.9.0** — Rename `SmimeProfile` → `SmimeMailboxValidated`
  for naming consistency with the rest of the tier surface. Pre-1.0
  breaking change. Prerequisite for Mailbox Multipurpose.
- **PKIX-jbvb.9.1** — `SmimeMailboxValidatedMultipurpose`. Blocks on .9.0.
- **PKIX-jbvb.9.2** — `SmimeOrganizationValidatedMultipurpose`. Blocks
  on PKIX-jbvb.1 (Org Strict, which is the template).
- **PKIX-jbvb.9.3** — `SmimeSponsorValidatedMultipurpose`. Strict
  sibling exists (PKIX-jbvb.7); not blocked.
- **PKIX-jbvb.9.4** — `SmimeIndividualValidatedMultipurpose`. Strict
  sibling exists (PKIX-jbvb.7); not blocked.

## Out of scope

- New `pkix-chain` wrappers. `verify_smime_signer` is already
  Profile-parameterized; no per-tier wrapper multiplication.
- "Try multiple tier Profiles" auto-discovery wrapper for callers
  receiving signed email of unknown tier. File separately if user
  demand surfaces — it exists independently of Multipurpose addition
  (Sponsor vs Individual is already a runtime tier-discovery question).
- Composite "Strict OR Multipurpose" single Profile via either-of
  `required_leaf_policy_oids`. The current `required_leaf_policy_oids`
  semantic per PKIX-jbvb.4 is allOf — would require a separate
  predicate axis to express anyOf-OID semantics. Out of scope here.

## Cross-references

- PKIX-jbvb (parent S/MIME sub-profile-families umbrella)
- PKIX-jbvb.6 (Strict-vs-Legacy decision, Strict selected as the modern target)
- PKIX-jbvb.7 (Sponsor + Individual Strict implementation; the template)
- PKIX-jbvb.8 (decision bead — closed yes, plan tracked here)
- PKIX-mzsk (spec-taxonomy principle — BR-named cells in scope)
- PKIX-e3nl (temporal-posture non-negotiable — neutral, Multipurpose is parallel current-tier)
title: pkix-profiles-cabf: S/MIME Multipurpose generation Profile types (4-tier sibling surface)
